verzen.tekst: It is better to be childless with virtue,
verzen.html: It is better to be childless with virtue,

verzen.tekst: When it is present, people imitate it.
verzen.html: When it is present, people imitate it.

verzen.tekst: But the multiplying brood of the ungodly will be of no profit,
verzen.html: But the multiplying brood of the ungodly will be of no profit,

verzen.tekst: For even if they grow branches and flourish for a season,
verzen.html: For even if they grow branches and flourish for a season,

verzen.tekst: Their branches will be broken off before they come to maturity.
verzen.html: Their branches will be broken off before they come to maturity.

verzen.tekst: For unlawfully conceived children are witnesses of wickedness
verzen.html: For unlawfully conceived children are witnesses of wickedness

verzen.tekst: But a righteous man, even if he dies before his time, will be at rest.
verzen.html: But a righteous man, even if he dies before his time, will be at rest.

verzen.tekst: For honourable old age is not that which stands in length of time,
verzen.html: For honourable old age is not that which stands in length of time,

verzen.tekst: but understanding is grey hair to men,
verzen.html: but understanding is grey hair to men,

verzen.tekst: Being found well-pleasing to God, someone was loved.
verzen.html: Being found well-pleasing to God, someone was loved.

verzen.tekst: He was caught away, lest evil should change his understanding,
verzen.html: He was caught away, lest evil should change his understanding,

verzen.tekst: For the fascination of wickedness obscures the things which are good,
verzen.html: For the fascination of wickedness obscures the things which are good,

verzen.tekst: Being made perfect quickly,
verzen.html: Being made perfect quickly,

verzen.tekst: for his soul was pleasing to the Lord.

verzen.tekst: But the peoples saw and didn’t understand,

verzen.tekst: but a righteous man who is dead will condemn the ungodly who are living,
verzen.html: but a righteous man who is dead will condemn the ungodly who are living,

verzen.tekst: For the ungodly will see a wise man’s end,
verzen.html: For the ungodly will see a wise man’s end,

verzen.tekst: They will see, and they will despise;
verzen.html: They will see, and they will despise;

verzen.tekst: because he will dash them speechless to the ground,
verzen.html: because he will dash them speechless to the ground,

verzen.tekst: They will come with coward fear when their sins are counted.
